en.title: Lufthansa to end 509-seat Airbus A380 operations, final flight on December 17
en.summary: Lufthansa will retire its 509-seat Airbus A380 configuration next month, with the final flight on December 17 from Munich to Los Angeles; only four routes will still see the high-density layout in its remaining weeks as the airline reconfigures the jets to a 499-seat layout with a new 1-2-1 business class.
body: Lufthansa is one of the few airlines that continue to operate the Airbus A380. According to ch-aviation, the German flag carrier currently has a fleet of eight A380-800s and plans to keep the aircraft in service well into the 2030s. The airline operates the double-deckers in two configurations, offering either 509 or 499 seats, but as reported by AeroRoutes, it is planning to end operations with its 509-seat A380s next month. The 509-seat layout features eight first-class suites, 78 business-class seats arranged in a 2-2-2 configuration, 53 premium economy seats and 371 economy seats, according to aeroLOPA.

The final flight using this configuration will operate on December 17, on the daily service between Munich Airport (MUC) and Los Angeles International Airport (LAX). Only four routes are scheduled to see the 509-seat A380 during its remaining weeks: Munich–Bangkok on November 15, 22 and 29; Munich–Delhi daily until December 8; Munich–Los Angeles on Wednesdays and Fridays until November 27, followed by December 10 and 17; and Munich–San Francisco on November 21 and 28. According to scheduling data from Cirium, the airline deployed the 509-seat jets this year on services from Munich to Bangkok, Mumbai, Delhi, Denver, Washington Dulles (IAD), Boston and San Francisco.

Lufthansa is gradually reconfiguring its 509-seat A380s to the 499-seat layout as part of a business-class cabin retrofit. The existing business class is more than a decade old and, with its 2-2-2 layout, gives only around 67% of passengers direct aisle access; the airline is replacing the seats with Thompson Aero Seating's Vantage XL product in a staggered 1-2-1 configuration, cutting business capacity from 78 to 68 seats. Four of Lufthansa's eight A380s have already received the new product, and the airline expects to complete the retrofit across its fleet by mid-2027. The A380 remains one of Lufthansa's main long-haul workhorses, with more than 3,400 flights scheduled between December 2026 and October 2027.

zh.title: 漢莎航空509座A380最後4條航線出爐、12月17日飛完最後一班
zh.summary: 漢莎航空下月起停用509座空中巴士A380布局，最後一班為12月17日慕尼黑往返洛杉磯；停用前僅剩4條航線會派飛此高密度布局，機隊將陸續改裝為499座布局並換上1-2-1新商務艙。
body: 漢莎航空是少數仍在營運空中巴士A380的航空公司之一。根據ch-aviation資料，這家德國籍航空目前擁有8架A380-800，並計畫讓該機型服役至2030年代。漢莎的A380有509座與499座兩種布局，據AeroRoutes報導，509座布局將於下月停用。根據aeroLOPA資料，509座布局設有8間頭等套房、78個2-2-2排列的商務艙座位、53個特選經濟艙座位與371個經濟艙座位。

509座布局的最後一班將於12月17日執飛慕尼黑往返洛杉磯的每日航班。停用前的最後數周，僅剩4條航線會派飛509座A380：慕尼黑—曼谷為11月15、22與29日；慕尼黑—德里每日飛至12月8日；慕尼黑—洛杉磯為每周三、五飛至11月27日，之後為12月10日與17日；慕尼黑—舊金山為11月21與28日。根據Cirium排班資料，漢莎今年曾以509座A380執飛慕尼黑往返曼谷、孟買、德里、丹佛、華盛頓杜勒斯、波士頓與舊金山。

漢莎正逐步將509座A380改裝為499座布局，作為商務艙翻新計畫的一部分。現有商務艙已有10多年歷史，2-2-2布局僅讓約67%的乘客能直接進出走道；漢莎將換裝Thompson Aero Seating的Vantage XL產品，採交錯式1-2-1布局，商務艙座位由78個減至68個。8架A380中已有4架完成改裝，全機隊預計2027年中完成。A380仍是漢莎長程航線主力之一，2026年12月至2027年10月間已排定逾3400個航班。
